coupon_value_shape.name: coupon_value_shape
coupon_value_shape.value:
("coupons"."discount_type" = 'fixed' AND "coupons"."amount_off_paise" > 0 AND "coupons"."percent_off" IS NULL)
       OR ("coupons"."discount_type" = 'percent' AND "coupons"."percent_off" BETWEEN 1 AND 90 AND "coupons"."amount_off_paise" IS NULL)
